verdict.rationale: HumanLayer offers a GitHub integration (docs-16) to create tasks from issues and a 'first session' tutorial (docs-1/23) suggesting quick onboarding, but the broader docs describe host selection, credential/tool access configuration, workspace.json setup, and launch tokens (docs-7, docs-8, docs-11, docs-13, docs-27) as prerequisites for granting an agent real repo access — this is far from a single-click install. Missing for 10: evidence of an actual one-click GitHub App/OAuth install flow, confirmation that no host/credential configuration is needed, and independent (non-vendor) confirmation of setup simplicity.
